items.q: he did contact me and booked three or four dates.

ctx.x: And then another--as I said perhaps so many in between, almost too numerous to name, but one I will not pass up, was Harry Burns. It was kind of odd and strange the way it came about. I was in McAlester, Oklahoma, which you consider that my territory booking, and Harry Burns then was booking--do you remember the Wings Over Joy (phonetic spelling), the gospel group, well he was booking them and he just knew the country from A to Z, where you'd be good when it's good in this town and this and that, and he wanted to…

ctx.x: I got hold of him, but Burns was one of these--he had this little office in New Orleans and he didn't advertise me as from Oklahoma, as exciting New Orleans style and sometimes I got a hold of him in New Orleans, but I have to say this, he did a terrific job in booking, because not having something that somebody is asking for, he was impressing--
